title: Quatre directions artistiques
intro: Quatre univers qui ne se ressemblent pas, chacun avec un hero photo d'art, une variante éditoriale et un packshot. Choisis une direction (ou deux, séparément).

jobs.label: Hero « photo d'art »
jobs.prompt:
Reference photos attached (3 images): the EXACT product to reproduce, only the colors change. A handmade surfboard carry sling: a flat rectangular panel of thick cotton canvas (about 60 x 48 cm) with two long flat cotton webbing straps. HOW IT IS WORN (important): the board passes THROUGH the loop formed by the panel and the straps: the panel wraps under and around the middle of the longboard, so the lower half of the panel is hidden under the board and only the upper part of the panel shows over the middle of the board; the straps go up over the shoulder; the board hangs horizontally at the hip, nose forward, tail behind; the board stays fully visible except its middle. A small round embroidered patch on the panel (a simple line drawing, no letters). Never a bag hanging in front of the body, never a zip, never padding.

ART PHOTOGRAPH, not a commercial image. In the manner of Sarah Moon and Todd Hido: a nocturne at Les Sables-d'Olonne, Vendée: the long Grande Plage at low tide under a hazy full moon, the far promenade lamps dissolved into soft halos, the row of small white beach cabins barely legible in the dark. A woman in a black long-sleeve swimsuit and loose ivory trousers walks along the water carrying a pale longboard in the sling (moon-ivory panel, night-navy straps); she is half-dissolved in a slow-shutter motion blur while the sand and the moon reflection stay sharp. Heavy organic grain, soft focus, cyan-blue and silver palette with one warm amber lamp, dreamlike, melancholic, painterly. Medium-format film, 1/4 s handheld. Subject on the right third, empty silver beach on the left.

Negative: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no extra fingers or limbs, no distorted hands, no plastic skin, no CGI look, no stock-photo smiles, no zip, no padded board cover.
